page_title: スマホで証明写真を作成 | Machi Photos

sources.entry: Machi Photos - Browser-based ID photo maker for compliant crops, AI background replacement, retouching, and convenience-store print sheets. #freemium

summary.name: Machi Photos
summary.one_liner: A browser-based tool for making Japanese ID photos (証明写真) from a smartphone picture, cropped to standard sizes and laid out for convenience-store L-size prints.
keywords: エントリーシート 写真
use_cases: make a 30x40mm resume photo from a phone selfie
print ID photos at a convenience store
prepare a photo for a 履歴書 or エントリーシート
create an AI-styled headshot with a suit or background
lay out six ID photos on one L-size print sheet
summary.what_it_does: The page walks through three steps: choose the use and size (currently 履歴書・エントリーシート, 30×40mm, 6 photos on an L-size sheet), adjust the photo by aligning face position and background, then confirm and print. Standard ID-photo crops are described as free. An AI style option creates a suit or background from a single selfie for 4 points per use. The output is intended for convenience-store printing as an L-size sheet.
notable: Standard ID photo crops are free; AI style generation costs 4 points per use
Layout of 6 photos on an L-size sheet for convenience-store printing
Adjusts face position and background to match resume/entry-sheet requirements
caveats: AI style photos use points (4 per generation), so they are not free
Page text does not state which points plans or prices apply
Print output depends on convenience-store printing, which is only described here as an L-size sheet
